title: Explain a benefit and the one step to take
audience: Employees who were sent the film and will give it five seconds
inputs: The plan summary: what the company adds, what the employee keeps and when, where in the portal to act and any deadline

sources.claim: Example Co. matches 100% of the first 3% and 50% of the next 2%; the match vests 33/66/100% over three years
sources.source: Example Co. retirement plan summary (sample: replace with your plan document)

note: Workplace arc: the gain in five seconds, the rule as coins, what you keep and when, the step done in the app, the line to repeat spoken over the finished step. Every picture is a fill-in-the-blank sketch: replace sketchText with the plan's words, sketchParams with its figures and sketchSay with the narration word each moment lands on (`clearframe sketch NAME` names every slot). Add expire (use it or lose it), deadline (an enrollment window) or choose (two plans) where the plan has one. See skills/clearframe-workplace/SKILL.md.

beats.vo: Every paycheck, there is free money on the table. Most of us leave some of it there.
Put in five percent of your pay, and the company adds four. That is nine percent, every paycheck.

sketchText.EACH: Each coin is 1% of your pay

beats.vo: The company's part becomes yours over time: a third after one year, two thirds after the second, and all of it after the third.
To change it, open Benefits, then Retirement. Set your rate to five percent, and save. Two minutes today, free money with every paycheck after.

sketchText.DONE: Saved: starts with your next paycheck
